Sometimes I feel tired.
Sometimes I want to feel grateful.
Sometimes I just want to be amazed. So I made a small web app — where scrolling = time passing in a day.
And as the hours go by, you see how much has already happened. Flowers bloomed
Hearts beat
Babies were born
The world moved forward You can scroll through the day, from 00:00 to 24:00, and watch the numbers grow smoothly. It's not a productivity tool. It's not a dashboard.
